exclusions.reason: Letter, contacts and association mission are incidental. Central ABAS lists and changed wording are requests; predicted uncertainty is not an observed legal-effect finding. Dynamic-reference transparency recommendations do not assert a separately quantified present outcome.

Proposed guidance, exceptions, synchronised LV23/TRBA100 updates, reduced documentation and predicted uneven enforcement/cost are recommendations or risks. Actual Annex II labels and asserted burden shift are separately retained.

Specific electronic-instruction wording, language, harmonisation and format clarification are proposals. Frequent combined-session premise is retained. Potential retrofit and running costs are prospective engineering/cost risks, not realised costs.

Transition periods, grandfathering/equivalence, evaluation and participation requests are normative. Forecasted technical work, finance, authorisations and validation are not fabricated as observed project burdens.
Cover, contents and organisation/contact page only.

General reform goals and approval are normative/background. Introductory EU-Biostoffverordnung wording is an incidental instrument label; the operative EU context is a directive, but no material policy-claim error is manufactured from this shorthand.

Proposed work-shoe clarification is normative; its classification premise and anonymous case are retained. Erroneous unrelated template footers and placeholder dates are incidental editorial metadata, not material biosafety assertions; the cover/authored date remains September 28.
Predicted expansion to infection control or newly covered occupations is a conditional risk, not an observed effect. Proposed retained/deleted wording and rescue clarification are recommendations.

Alternative §8 wording and proposed where necessary clothing addition address ambiguity; they do not assert that the draft necessarily forces duplicate garments in every case. Proposed safety-awareness sentence is normative; current workplace requirement and claimed usual digital shortfall are separately assessed.

limits: All twelve assigned physical pages read before older dispositions/counterpart inventories.
DGUV content is assessed; its administrative/public-body versus eligible external-response status remains pending. No external denominator is inferred.

Current October-metadata draft is not silently substituted for the August file addressed in September. Current enacted law, 2025 technical rules and 2019 EU annex changes are independently assessed where available.
No author contact, specialist confirmation or inference of intent. Scientific/technical uncertainty, professional judgment and forecasts are not error findings.
